means: Constructed replays, one per drawn node of harddrop's Gamushiro Stacking second bag and 8-line Perfect Clears: our own piece queue and key inputs, run from an empty board through the vendored Triangle engine, ending on the page's drawn board. Not a game anyone played and not corpus data.
not_eligible_because: not a game anyone played; not corpus data
one engine, no second implementation of the boards

caveat.order: The page states one bag-1 order (J before S). Everything else is ours: the first piece of each before-pair first, then IOTSZJL, the T into the U slot last. order_reading records it per bag. The page's arrows (L → O and so on) name the forms and are not read as orders: Form A2's board contradicts its arrow.
caveat.hold: bag1.left holds its L when it arrives (our choice of where: just before the bag's S). The hold box is then never empty again: the held L comes out at its slot in bag 2, swapped for the piece that bag places last.
caveat.chain: The 8-line PC patterns hang under each form family's after-the-TST board; their demos run through the form whose TST leaves it (A1 for the A family).
caveat.spin: Every T-spin kind and line count is the engine's verdict on the replayed inputs. PC patterns that draw the T flat in the TSD slot fire it as a TSD, except those named in TSD_NOT_FIRED, whose T is placed last, with no spin.
